@pytest.mark.parametrize('dnt, accept_language, custom_headers, expected', [
    # DNT
    (True, None, {}, {b'DNT': b'1'}),
    (False, None, {}, {b'DNT': b'0'}),
    (None, None, {}, {}),
    # Accept-Language
    (False, 'de, en', {}, {b'DNT': b'0', b'Accept-Language': b'de, en'}),

                                          b'Accept-Language': b'de, en',
                                          b'X-Qute': b'yes'}),
])
def test_custom_headers(config_stub, dnt, accept_language, custom_headers,
                        expected):
    headers = config_stub.val.content.headers
    headers.do_not_track = dnt
    headers.accept_language = accept_language
    headers.custom = custom_headers

    expected_items = sorted(expected.items())
    assert shared.custom_headers(url=None) == expected_items

    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'userscript:style', 'Unexpected error', True),
    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.warning, 'userscript:style', 'Unexpected error', False),
    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'page:style', 'Unexpected error', False),
    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'userscript:style',
     'Refused to apply inline style because of CSP', False),
    (usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'userscript:other',

     'Refused to apply inline style because of CSP', True),
])
def test_js_log_to_ui(config_stub, message_mock, caplog,
                      level, source, msg, expected):
    settings = config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message
    settings.levels = {'userscript:*': ['error'], 'qute:*': ['error']}
    settings.excludes = {'userscript:style': ['Refused to apply inline style*'],
                         'userscript:*': ['*because of CSP']}

    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR):
        assert shared._js_log_to_ui(level, source, 66, msg) is expected
    if expected:
        ui_msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
        assert ui_msg.text == f'JS: [{source}:66] {msg}'
    else:
